description: Start the Best Of Motivation Leadership Style Quiz (15 questions, about 5 minutes). Use when the user wants to find out their leadership or management style, or asks for a leadership quiz. Returns the questions. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which style an option points to, and do not guess the result yourself: when all 15 are answered, call score_leadership_style_quiz.
name: start_leadership_style_quiz
title: Start the Leadership Style Quiz
